fields.name: Number Theory
fields.description: The study of the integers and the structures built from them — prime numbers, and the rational, algebraic, and $p$-adic numbers that extend them. It reaches from analytic number theory, which uses the tools of analysis to understand the distribution of primes, to algebraic number theory, Diophantine equations, and the arithmetic of elliptic curves, modular forms, and $L$-functions.
